echo "=== ledger snapshot before second prepare-final ==="
wc -l "$LEDGER"

python3 -B -c "import json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('$LEDGER');

echo "=== second prepare-final ==="
python3 -B "$SKILL/scripts/workflow_run.py" prepare-final --repo "$REPO" --expected-head "$HEAD" | tee /tmp/gsd-path-grok-prepare-final-2.json

echo "=== after second ==="
echo HEAD=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse HEAD)
git -C "$REPO" status --porcelain

wc -l "$LEDGER"
shasum -a 256 "$LEDGER"
python3 -B -c "import json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('$LEDGER');
print('entries', len(p.read_text().splitlines()));
print('commits', [json.loads(l)['commit'] for l in p.read_text().splitlines()])"
